newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 168-day T-bill yields average 24.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 168-day T-bill yields average 24.87 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 168-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 24.87 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the yield would be in the 25.34-26.66 percent range.
The 22083-series bills, maturing on November 12, 1997, the closest maturity date to the new issue, on Tuesday closed at 88.80, to yield 26.16 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
Earlier on Wednesday, the Finance Ministry sold 4.26 trillion roubles in an issue of 364-day T-bills (series 23007), bringing total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.53 trillion roubles.
It also repaid seven trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 238-day T-bills (series 22051).
